subroutine tensor_dp(n,rank,shifts,invariants,masses,mu2,coefs,status, &
                       pole_mode,compute_finite,check_pass,cache_enabled)
    integer, intent(in) :: n,rank
    real(KI_TIR), intent(in) :: shifts(0:,:),invariants(:,:),mu2
    complex(KI_TIR), intent(in) :: masses(:)
    complex(KI_TIR), intent(out) :: coefs(:,:)
    integer, intent(out) :: status
    integer, intent(in), optional :: pole_mode
    logical, intent(in), optional :: compute_finite,check_pass,cache_enabled
    integer(c_int) :: poles,finite,check,cache
    coefs = cmplx(0,0,kind=KI_TIR)
    if (.not.valid_shapes(n,rank,shape(shifts),shape(invariants),size(masses),shape(coefs),status)) return
    call options(pole_mode,compute_finite,check_pass,cache_enabled,poles,finite,check,cache)
    call ensure_context(status)
    if (status /= TIRUST_SUCCESS) return
    status = evaluate_dp(context,int(n,c_int),int(rank,c_int),shifts,size(shifts,kind=c_size_t), &
                         invariants,size(invariants,kind=c_size_t),masses,size(masses,kind=c_size_t), &
                         mu2,coefs,size(coefs,kind=c_size_t),poles,finite,check,cache)
    if (status /= TIRUST_SUCCESS) coefs = cmplx(0,0,kind=KI_TIR)
  end subroutine

WRITE(*,'(A,5I12)') 'STABILITY_CALL_BEGIN ',PHASE,
     $ CALL_INDEX,POINT_INDEX,METHOD,MODE
      FLUSH(6)
      CALL STABILITY_FLAG_BEFORE(PHASE,CALL_INDEX,POINT_INDEX,
     $ METHOD)
      CALL @PREFIX@SLOOPMATRIX_THRES(P,ANS,-1D0,ACC,CODE)
C     An unchecked 110 can hide a failed tensor contribution. Snapshot
C     the actual active-group state before accepting any metric. The
C     snapshot only copies bits and performs integer operations; it does
C     not clear native flags, perform FP classification or alter COMMON.
      CALL STABILITY_GROUP_SNAPSHOT(PHASE,CALL_INDEX,POINT_INDEX,
     $ METHOD,NSO)
      WRITE(*,'(A,6I12)') 'STABILITY_CALL_END ',PHASE,
     $ CALL_INDEX,POINT_INDEX,METHOD,MODE,CODE
      FLUSH(6)

LOGICAL FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION,FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION
      COMMON/@PREFIX@FPE_IN_REDUCTION/FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION,
     $ FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION
C     These native logical flags have DATA initialization in the bound
C     matrix source. Forced positive modes may leave them sticky across
C     calls, so preserve the incoming state without resetting anything.
      WRITE(77,'(A,6I12)') 'B',PHASE,CALL_INDEX,POINT_INDEX,
     $ METHOD,MERGE(1,0,FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION),
     $ MERGE(1,0,FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION)

FPE_DP=MERGE(1,0,FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION)
      FPE_QP=MERGE(1,0,FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION)
      IF(NSO.NE.NSQUAREDSO.OR..NOT.LOOP_REQ_SO_DONE.OR.
     $ SQSO_TARGET.NE.-1.OR.FILTER_SO) GOTO 200
      COVERAGE=1
      DO I=1,NLOOPGROUPS
         DO J=1,NSQUAREDSO
            NZ=0
            NF_COEF=0
            FIRST_NZ=0_INT64
            DO K=0,STABILITY_NCOEFS(I)-1
               WORDS=TRANSFER(LOOPCOEFS(K,J,I),WORDS)
               DO L=1,2
                  IF(IAND(WORDS(L),MAG_MASK).NE.0_INT64) THEN
                     IF(NZ.EQ.0) FIRST_NZ=WORDS
                     NZ=NZ+1
                  ENDIF
                  IF(IAND(WORDS(L),EXP_MASK).EQ.EXP_MASK)
     $                 NF_COEF=NF_COEF+1
               ENDDO
            ENDDO
            STABLE=-1
            NF_RES=0
C           Inactive flags are not consulted. A nonfinite coefficient
C           is nonzero and therefore active; signed zeros are inactive.
            IF(NZ.GT.0) THEN
               ACTIVE=ACTIVE+1
               STABLE=MERGE(1,0,S(J,I))
               IF(STABLE.EQ.0) FAILED=FAILED+1
               IF(NF_COEF.GT.0) COEF_BAD=COEF_BAD+1
            ENDIF
            RES_WORDS=TRANSFER(LOOPRES(:,J,I),RES_WORDS)
            DO L=1,6
               IF(IAND(RES_WORDS(L),EXP_MASK).EQ.EXP_MASK)
     $              NF_RES=NF_RES+1
            ENDDO
            IF(NZ.GT.0.AND.NF_RES.GT.0) RES_BAD=RES_BAD+1
            WRITE(77,'(A,11I12,8(1X,Z16.16))') 'G',PHASE,
     $           CALL_INDEX,POINT_INDEX,METHOD,J,I,
     $           STABILITY_NCOEFS(I),NZ,NF_COEF,STABLE,NF_RES,
     $           FIRST_NZ,RES_WORDS
         ENDDO
      ENDDO

     $ METHOD,COVERAGE,ACTIVE,FAILED,COEF_BAD,RES_BAD,FPE_DP,FPE_QP

SUBROUTINE ML5_0_SLOOPMATRIX(P_USER,ANS)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER NEXTERNAL
      PARAMETER (NEXTERNAL=5)
      REAL*8 P_USER(0:3,NEXTERNAL),ANS(0:3,*)
      LOGICAL NRS_RETRY_MODE,NRS_RETRY_USED
      INTEGER NRS_RETRY_COUNT,NRS_RETRY_PASS,NRS_RETRY_FAIL
      INTEGER NRS_RETRY_HARD_SKIP
      REAL*8 NRS_NATIVE_ACC,NRS_COMP_ACC
      COMMON/ML5_0_NRS_RETRY_FLAGS/NRS_RETRY_MODE,NRS_RETRY_USED
      COMMON/ML5_0_NRS_RETRY_STATS/NRS_RETRY_COUNT,NRS_RETRY_PASS,
     $ NRS_RETRY_FAIL,NRS_RETRY_HARD_SKIP
      COMMON/ML5_0_NRS_RETRY_ACC/NRS_NATIVE_ACC,NRS_COMP_ACC
      NRS_RETRY_MODE=.FALSE.
      NRS_RETRY_USED=.FALSE.
      NRS_RETRY_COUNT=0
      NRS_RETRY_PASS=0
      NRS_RETRY_FAIL=0
      NRS_RETRY_HARD_SKIP=0
      NRS_NATIVE_ACC=-1D0
      NRS_COMP_ACC=-1D0
      CALL ML5_0_SLOOPMATRIX_RETRY_IMPL(P_USER,ANS)
C     Guaranteed reset after every ordinary return from the
C      implementation.
      NRS_RETRY_MODE=.FALSE.
      END

LOGICAL FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION, FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION
      DATA FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION, FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION/.FALSE.,.FALSE./
      COMMON/ML5_0_FPE_IN_REDUCTION/FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION,
     $  FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION

IF(.NOT.CHECKPHASE.AND.HELDOUBLECHECKED.AND.(CTMODERUN.EQ.-1))
     $  THEN
        STAB_INDEX=STAB_INDEX+1
        IF(DOING_QP_EVALS.AND.LOOPLIBS_QPAVAILABLE(MLREDUCTIONLIB(I_LIB)
     $   )) THEN

C             A new reduction tool will be used. Reinitialize the FPE
C              flags.
              FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION=.FALSE.
              FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION=.FALSE.
              I_LIB=INDEX_QP_TOOLS(I_QP_LIB)
              EVAL_DONE(1)=.TRUE.

C             A new reduction tool will be used. Reinitialize the FPE
C              flags.
              FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION=.FALSE.
              FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION=.FALSE.
              I_QP_LIB=1
              DOING_QP_EVALS=.TRUE.
              EVAL_DONE(1)=.TRUE.

C             A new reduction tool will be used. Reinitialize the FPE
C              flags.
              FPE_IN_DP_REDUCTION=.FALSE.
              FPE_IN_QP_REDUCTION=.FALSE.
              EVAL_DONE(1)=.TRUE.
